decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends the firm's established spraying line and has been shown on the website in both years, so the engineering investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The injection pump has its own page and a publicized construction-site field test dating back to 2021, so years of development and public commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
The low-pressure pump line reuses the firm's proven air motors and was publicly announced as new, so dropping it would write off sunk development for little saving.
Fire protection flow monitoring has a dedicated page and supports the firm's stated digitalization direction, so it is central to its announced strategy.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so weak early results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
